causebase_summary: The APNIC Foundation Limited is a Queensland-registered organisation that the Foundation’s 2025 annual report describes as an Asia Pacific digital development organisation. The report states the Foundation invested USD 10 million in 2025 across three strategic pillars (Building Capabilities, Driving Digital Innovation, Supporting Digital Transformation) and says it reached communities and practitioners in 30 economies. Reported 2025 outputs include 11,533 people trained, more than 196,700 individuals said to have directly benefited from digital inclusion efforts, and support for digital transformation work in three economies. Program examples named in the report and on the website include ISIF Asia (29 grants across 19 economies; USD 2.31 million in grants in 2025), Switch! (a cohort of 150 women and gender-diverse participants across six Southeast Asian economies), Digital Leap South Asia (DLSA in three South Asian economies) and the RISE‑PH ISIF grantee that the report says connected 53 school sites (51 public schools and 2 teacher‑training colleges; an estimated 80,000–100,000 students). The report and website describe partnerships with APNIC and Keio University, Foundation-led infrastructure activities (M-root deployments, local infrastructure sites), instructor-led and self-paced training, and public events such as SOI Asia and summits.

data.SummaryOfActivities: In 2025, we invested USD 10 million (AUD ~15 million) across our three strategic pillars: Building Capabilities, Driving Digital Innovation, and Supporting Digital Transformation. Together with our partners, we reached communities and practitioners across 30 economies in the Asia Pacific region, delivered capability-building initiatives for 11,533 people, contributed to digital inclusion efforts that directly benefited more than 196,700 individuals and supported digital transformation across 3 economies.

data.ActivityInternationalDescription: We help build technical and human capabilities across the Asia Pacific, ensuring that everyone can use and benefit from expanded infrastructure, enhanced access, and increased human capacity to support and benefit from digital technologies. Our initiatives focus on empowering individuals and communities to participate fully in the digital economy and society.  We champion the development and deployment of digital innovation, new and emerging technologies that are designed with and for diverse communities, ensuring no one is left behind. Our approach to innovation is rooted in equity, leveraging new technologies to bridge divides and create solutions that are accessible, affordable, relevant, and help to better lives.  We foster environments where emerging ideas can be piloted, replicated, scaled, and shared, thus amplifying impact across the region and beyond.  Our programs bridge the gap between technology and policy, and help further socio-economic progress in the region.
